NEOW.talk.MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.0-0: [sine]...another... tinkerer... ...show me... what you... would... build....[/sine]
NEOW.talk.MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.0-1: A colossal eye. Unknown biology. May I take a sample?
NEOW.talk.MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.2-1: Good. I have questions only he can answer.
DARV.talk.MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.0-0: Buy something, or get out. Unless you have something worth trading.
DARV.talk.MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.0-1: This wrench? Prototype. It trades for a relic.
DARV.talk.MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.2-0: You still owe me a potion.
OROBAS.talk.MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.0: A new shape. Show me what you would become.
Upgrade me? I have a list.
OROBAS.talk.MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.2: The rainbow bends around your gear.
PAEL.talk.MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.0-1: Melt this sample and I will learn.
NONUPEIPE.talk.MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIS: Randomness is the only true science.
Finally, someone who understands my lab.
VAKUU.talk.MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.0-: A deal. Your ethics for power.
My ethics are already a variable.
TANX.talk.MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.0-0: You stitch things together too. Show me.
TANX.talk.MADSCIENTIST-MAD_SCIENTIST.0-1: I fuse cards. You fuse beasts. We are colleagues.
